name: writer
description: OpenAlex-backed research, paper writing, native OMML DOCX export, and submission checks.

interface.shortDescription: Research, write, typeset, and verify papers
interface.longDescription: Search and verify scholarly literature, synthesize evidence, write mathematical modeling papers, export LaTeX math as native Word OMML, and check citations, numerical consistency, and final document quality.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-writing to write a paper from my verified results with OpenAlex references.
Use $paper-lookup to find and preserve provenance for relevant scholarly sources.
Use $export-math-docx to export LaTeX math as native OMML equations in Word.
